changelog:
Initial release of lygo-skill-gate — a local, pure-stdlib risk scanner for OpenClaw/ClawHub skills.

- Scans skill folders for risky patterns: subprocess/shell, network/HTTP, secrets, eval/exec, permission-claim mismatches.
- No network, subprocess, or auto-install actions; operates entirely offline.
- Outputs exit codes to indicate risk (clear, elevated, high/critical, not a skill).
- CLI tools provided for scanning by path or slug, self-check, and consent-based report export.
- Useful for manual skill audit, agent pre-install checks, and workflow safety gates.
summary: LYGO Skill Gate — local pre-install skill risk scanner for OpenClaw/ClawHub packages. Scan any skill folder before you install or trust it: subprocess/shell, network/HTTP, secrets in source, eval/exec, webhook/exfil hints, permission-claim mismatches. Use when auditing ClawHub skills, reviewing SKILL.md safety, safe install checks, malware triage, or SkillSpector-style local gates. Pure stdlib. No network, no subprocess, no auto-install. Install clawhub:@deepseekoracle/lygo-skill-gate.
